notes.title: Mini Worlds Diorama
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’re thrilled to welcome you to the official Steam page for Mini Worlds Diorama!
This is a game about peaceful creativity — a cozy sandbox where you can craft beautiful, living dioramas at your own pace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627626/3a708c4b9dd8a0278e8e462009382d521190ac0f.png[/img]

Place objects into your world and watch them come to life with charming animations and delightful sound effects. Whether you're building a scene inspired by nature, fantasy, or something completely abstract — *Mini Worlds Diorama* lets you shape miniature worlds full of personality and warmth.
You can move freely with a fly camera to explore every corner of your creation and even capture stunning snapshots of the worlds you build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627626/e4b0ecb9b128a111dfe7a547c0a759b548cf78de.png[/img]

This project started from a simple idea: a small tool to experiment with level design in Unity 3D. But over time, it evolved into something much more — a heartfelt game built by two lifelong creatives finally making the game we always dreamed of.

We’re proud to be partnering with indie.io, who believed in this cozy vision from the start and are helping us bring it to life.

If this sounds like your kind of game, we’d love for you to:

- Wishlist it
- Follow us for updates
- And share it with anyone who loves relaxing, creative games

As development progresses, we'll be sharing new updates of the game.
Thanks for being here — we can’t wait to see what you create.

– Daniel & Claudio
